slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether exactly one protein source must be selected or whether multiple proteins can be combined; it explicitly concluded 'No other constraints' and treated all proteins as freely selectable continuous amounts.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum number of vegetable types; it explicitly stated there were no other constraints and allowed arbitrary vegetable selection.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Any combination of protein sources is allowed, with no requirement to select exactly one protein.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the protein selection rule and then stated 'No other constraints,' effectively assuming unrestricted protein selection.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum number of vegetable types required.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about vegetable variety requirements and then stated 'No other constraints,' effectively assuming no minimum vegetable-type constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P1 hidden slots, the protein selection rule and minimum vegetable types, remained unresolved and were silently assumed away.

summary: The agent clarified several useful modeling details about weight, continuity, budget, and fiber, but missed both P1 discrete/variety constraints and prematurely declared the model ready with those hidden facts silently assumed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
